image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The image focuses on the texture of the cut interior and the glazed top crust. The meatloaf has a browned, glossy exterior with a reddish hue typical of a tomato-based glaze. The interior shows a dense, ground meat texture with visible lighter flecks (likely onions or breadcrumbs). The lighting highlights the moisture and oil content of the dish.

Standard depth-of-field blur is present. It appears natural, but the transition between the sharp foreground and blurred background is slightly abrupt, typical of generative models focusing on a central subject.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'smudged' nature of the internal ingredients. In real meatloaf, onions and breadcrumbs have distinct edges. If they look like melted paint, this is a significant texture anomaly. Also, verify if the glaze looks like a liquid layer sitting on top or if it merges unnaturally with the meat crust.
